watch.say: A lander needs the Sun for power and Earth for radio. This is the Moon from above its south pole, lit as it is now: press play.

markers.say: Each marker is a landing site. Its shape and color say what it can see at this moment: the Sun, Earth, both or neither.

plan.say: Choose where to land, when, and which mission. Everything below answers for that plan.

verdict.say: Sightline says whether the landing fits the mission, and why. If it does not, it offers the next landing that does.

skyline.say: This is the real skyline around the site, with the Sun and Earth where they stand at that hour. A body below the skyline is out of view.

time.say: The bands show the weeks after landing: green is the Sun and Earth both in view. Move along them, then press "land here" to try that hour.

compare.say: Press the plus to add another site or date, up to four. Compare sets them side by side, and the Planner gives them the whole window.

scout.say: Ask Scout in plain words: he looks the answer up in the same data. Home takes you back to the Moon.
